rows.title: Where the second baseline disappears -- fixed-table and memory-constrained BSGS under an ENFORCED table ceiling at 16 to 28 bits, against rho on shared instances, with the per-entry memory cost measured rather than assumed and the crossover reported as measured or as a bound

replication.seeds_note: DELIBERATELY EMPTY HERE BECAUSE THE SEEDS ARE INHERITED, NOT DRAWN. This contract reuses the frozen instance set of EXP-ECDLP-4320a7 verbatim, including its per-instance seeds, so that every comparison is paired against the same rho measurements. The BINDING requirement is that the inherited master seed and the derived per-instance seeds are recorded in this contract's manifests, and that no arm draws a fresh instance. A run that generates its own instances has broken the pairing and is completed_invalid. If EXP-ECDLP-4320a7 has not been approved and run, the instance set must be generated once under a recorded master seed and frozen before any arm runs.
replication.independent_instances_note: Two full independent executions, required to produce identical group operation counts, identical table entry counts and identical arm verdicts. Both arms are deterministic given the instance and the budget, so any difference is an implementation or environment defect. Peak resident bytes may differ between executions by allocator noise and are required to agree only within a declared 5 percent tolerance, which is recorded rather than assumed.

rows.rank_rationale: A fully charged baseline is needed for comparisons, but frozen instances and a genuine memory limit are prerequisites.
